tools.description: Creates an entry with a title and text (Markdown, one paragraph per line: **bold**, *italic*, <u>underline</u>, ~~strike~~, * or - lists, 1. numbered, two spaces per indent level, > quote.), dated now or on date, in a journal, bookmarked if asked. Journal uploads it to iCloud; the answer says whether it has yet.

journal.description: The journal to put it in (name or id); default none, so only All Entries shows it

tools.name: create_entry
tools.title: Create a journal entry

tools.description: Moves an entry to Recently Deleted, where Journal keeps it for 30 days and restore_entry brings it back. permanently deletes one already in Recently Deleted for good, on every device (ask the user first). An entry changed since its version was read is refused.

permanently.description: Delete an entry in Recently Deleted for good

version.description: The version read_entry or find_entries gave

tools.name: delete_entry
tools.title: Delete a journal entry

tools.description: Copies an entry with its text, date, journal and attachments, as Journal's Duplicate does.
tools.name: duplicate_entry
tools.title: Duplicate a journal entry

tools.description: Changes an entry in one call: its title, its text (body rewrites it all; replace swaps exact Markdown from read_entry, pairs applied in order; append adds Markdown at the end), its date, bookmark or journal. Only what changes is written; the rest keeps its formatting. An entry changed since its version was read is refused.

append.description: Markdown to add at the end of the text

journal.description: Move it to this journal (name or id); "" takes it out of its journal

old.description: Exact Markdown; must be unique unless all

version.description: The version read_entry or find_entries gave

tools.name: edit_entry
tools.title: Edit a journal entry

tools.description: Writes entries as Markdown files, one per entry, with their photos, videos and recordings, into a new folder. Filters as find_entries: journal, bookmarked, after (inclusive), before (exclusive).

after.description: 2026-10-21: entries dated that day or later

tools.name: export_entries
tools.title: Export journal entries

tools.description: Finds entries, newest first: by words (in the title, the text, the writing prompt, and the places, people, songs, transcripts and handwriting of attachments), journal, bookmark, date and kind of attachment. Each comes with its id and version, a snippet and its attachments by kind. after is inclusive, before exclusive.

after.description: 2026-10-21: entries dated that day or later

attachments.description: Only entries with an attachment of one of these kinds; any, or none

journal.description: Only entries in this journal (name or id)

offset.description: Skip this many, for the next page

sort.description: Default newest (by the entry's date); edited: most recently changed first

tools.name: find_entries
tools.title: Find journal entries

annotations.title: Create, change or delete a journal

tools.description: Creates a journal, changes one's name, color or icon, or deletes one. Deleting moves its entries to another journal (move_entries_to), leaves them in All Entries only (the default), or with delete_entries moves them to Recently Deleted too (ask the user first; expected_entries is how many it holds). The default journal cannot be changed.

color.description: #RRGGBB, or red, orange, yellow, green, mint, teal, cyan, blue, indigo, purple, pink, brown, gray

delete_entries.description: delete: move its entries to Recently Deleted too

expected_entries.description: delete with delete_entries: how many entries it holds

icon.description: An emoji, or an SF Symbol name such as book.closed

journal.description: New journal name for create; journal name or id otherwise

move_entries_to.description: delete: the journal to move its entries to (name or id)

tools.name: manage_journal
tools.title: Create, change or delete a journal

tools.description: The journals (with their colors, icons and how many entries each holds), how many entries there are in all, bookmarked and in Recently Deleted, and the insights Journal shows: days journaled and daily and weekly streaks.
tools.name: overview
tools.title: Journal overview

tools.description: Opens one of an entry's attachments (its id from read_entry): photos, a frame of a video, audio recordings (with Journal's transcript), and the details of places, State of Mind, workouts, music and the rest.

text_only.description: Only the details, no images or audio

tools.name: read_attachment
tools.title: Read an attachment

tools.description: Reads entries in full: the text as Markdown, the date, journal, bookmark, writing prompt, and each attachment's details (places, State of Mind, workouts, music, a recording's transcript, …), with the version edit_entry and delete_entry take. ![…](attachment:id) placeholders mark attachments placed in the text; read_attachment opens any attachment.
tools.name: read_entry
tools.title: Read journal entries

tools.description: Brings an entry back from Recently Deleted (find_entries with deleted: true lists them).
tools.name: restore_entry
tools.title: Restore a journal entry
